clips.title: The story
paras: Tasked directly by Commander Althea Ebonlocke, adventurers are sent into Duskwood's haunted barrows to cull the rising tide of restless dead. This ongoing campaign targets the skeletal horrors clawing their way out of Tranquil Gardens Cemetery and Raven Hill. Driving back the skeletal scourge is essential to keeping the fragile haven of Darkshire from falling completely to the darkness.

Duskwood's tragic descent from a verdant forest into a fog-drenched twilight has left its graveyards unnaturally restless. Commander Althea Ebonlocke, leading Darkshire's volunteer militia known as The Night Watch, faces an endless siege. Without aid from Stormwind, her forces are stretched dangerously thin. Reports of animated skeletal fiends and horrors rising from the dirt threaten to overrun the eastern settlements, forcing the militia to recruit any able-bodied travelers willing to enter the deadlands.

The campaign takes recruits to two focal points of necromantic unrest: the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery just south of town, and the vast, overgrown expanses of Raven Hill Graveyard to the far west. Skeletons pull themselves from forgotten tombs and shallow roadside graves, animated by dark magic lingering in the shadowed forest. Cutting down these fiends buys vital breathing room for Darkshire's beleaguered citizens, though it remains a ceaseless battle against an entrenched evil.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, I'm getting reports of an undead infestation in the forest! If you're up to the job, journey to the Raven Hill graveyard and slay 15 of those vile Skeletal Fiends and 15 Skeletal Horrors. There are also reports of skeletons just south of Darkshire, in and around Tranquil Gardens Cemetery. The undead must be driven from Duskwood!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Return to me once you have killed 15 Skeletal Fiends and 15 Skeletal Horrors, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The people of Darkshire thank you, friend. You have proven yourself to be a great ally of The Night Watch.
